subtitleId: Rekayasa Sistem, Arsitektur Web, & Inovasi Teknologi
subtitleEn: System Engineering, Web Architecture, & Tech Innovation
bioId: Saya adalah seorang Software Engineer berdedikasi dengan fokus pada pengembangan sistem perangkat lunak yang andal, scalable, dan modern. Berbekal latar belakang kuat dalam pengembangan full-stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel), virtualisasi server (Proxmox VE & Docker), serta integrasi AI/LLM, saya berkomitmen untuk menciptakan solusi digital berdampak tinggi.
bioEn: I am a dedicated Software Engineer focused on developing reliable, scalable, and modern software systems. Equipped with a strong background in full-stack development (Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel), server virtualization (Proxmox VE & Docker), and AI/LLM integration, I am committed to delivering high-impact digital solutions.

pillars.descId: Membangun antarmuka web interaktif berkinerja tinggi menggunakan Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, dan Laravel API backend.
pillars.descEn: Building high-performance interactive web interfaces using Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Laravel API backends.

pillars.descId: Mengelola server homelab enterprise berbasis Proxmox VE, kontainerisasi Docker Swarm, serta deployment otomatis di Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
pillars.descEn: Managing enterprise homelab servers based on Proxmox VE, Docker Swarm containerization, and automated deployments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

pillars.descId: Mengembangkan solusi kecerdasan buatan, sistem RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), dan bot otomatisasi workflows.
pillars.descEn: Developing artificial intelligence solutions, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, and workflow automation bots.

pillars.descId: Penggelaran aplikasi di Google Cloud Platform (GCP), optimasi query database PostgreSQL & MySQL, dan arsitektur otentikasi berbasis peran (RBAC).
pillars.descEn: Application deployment on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), PostgreSQL & MySQL database query optimization, and role-based authentication architecture (RBAC).
